@eslint-react/x-no-missing-context-displ: Its fix writes code that does not parse: `X.displayName = "X";` lands before the declaration's statement (gate, 5.19.0; re-measured on 5.24.10, still so).
perfectionist/sort-arrays: Reorders values whose order the program reads: ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'] was sorted, so 1 MB printed as "1.0 KB" (gate, measured).
perfectionist/sort-maps: Reorders entries whose order the program reads, as sort-arrays does (gate).
perfectionist/sort-objects: Reorders keys whose order the program reads, as sort-arrays does (gate).
perfectionist/sort-sets: Reorders members whose order the program reads, as sort-arrays does (gate).
unicorn/prefer-optional-catch-binding: P3: its fix removes an unused `catch (error)` binding, after which preserve-caught-error, which has no fix, no longer reports the missing `cause`, so the cause is lost silently (measured, check-fixes F-5).
